items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I did a lot of things for Savoy with a combination trumpet, tenor, and three rhythm, and Lubinsky... Herman Lubinsky, he was, he was the owner of the label.

ctx.x: Yes. Teddy Reig was connected with Savoy label at that time. I did a lot of things for Savoy with a combination trumpet, tenor, and three rhythm, and Lubinsky...

Herman Lubinsky, he was, he was the owner of the label. I just forget all the names, the tunes that we did, but I liked the label very much. It was one of those good old stomp down, drag out labels, you know, where you'd get up there and swing and stomp and go on, and I did quite a few recording dates for Savoy.
